## What and why

## Definition of Done (see docs/DEFINITION-OF-DONE.md): write n/a + reason, do not skip
- [ ] Security (no personal data collected, no secrets or private files, CSP) and a test that tries to break it
- [ ] Privacy & law (data minimised; privacy.html / terms.html still true; minors protected; version bumped if material)
- [ ] Accessibility (keyboard, focus, labels, contrast in both themes, screen reader, plain language)
- [ ] Speed (perf budget, lazy loading, slow-network check)
- [ ] Reliability & incident readiness (failure modes, how to revert)
- [ ] Tests green and run more than once (content tool, watchdog, perf budget, e2e)
- [ ] Docs / owner steps updated
- [ ] What was NOT verified and the remaining risk:
